bullets.section: Tote bag I decided to purchase, and I never buy tote bags —
bullets.title: School of Life bag, which reads “No one…”
Nomadic Homes
bullets.note: “This illustrated volume, written and edited by Philip Jodidio contains some of the most remarkable examples of homes on the move. Starting with totally revamped Airstream mobile homes, and going on to spectacular yachts like Philippe Starck’s Motor Yacht A, this book doesn’t stop moving, surveying the best in campers and tents, and even going on to private jets in the A319 or Boeing 737 category, veritable flying palaces for the privileged few. At the other end of the spectrum, we find refugee housing for those forced into a life on the move, including shelters designed by the Pritzker Prize–winning architect Shigeru Ban.”

bullets.section: What I’m watching and thinking about —
bullets.title: Free Solo
bullets.note: ,** a new documentary in theaters now, should have been titled WHATTHEFUCKOHMYGODHOLYSHIT. I think everyone in the audience lost at least a pound through palm sweat alone. It chronicles free-solo climbing phenom [Alex Honnold](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkmzxg/w6c2hghw26eo5/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE2LzA1LzE3L2FsZXgtaG9ubm9sZC8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249NWJm) as he prepares for the ridiculous, the death-inviting, the absolutely impossible: climbing “El Capitan,” the legendary 3,000-foot monster in Yosemite National Park, without any ropes. Beautifully directed and produced by [Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkmzxg/0kswh9hd6r379/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3V0c2lkZW9ubGluZS5jb20vMjM0MjEyNi9FbGl6YWJldGgtQ2hhaS1WYXNhcmhlbHlpLWZyZWUtc29sby1tb3ZpZQ==) and [Jimmy Chin](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkmzxg/vma3hrhp9rzk4/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE1LzEwLzIwL3RoZS1hdGhsZXRlLWFuZC1hcnRpc3Qtd2hvLWNoZWF0cy1kZWF0aC1qaW1teS1jaGluLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj01YmY=), this is one movie that will not let your mind wander one iota. Go see it on the biggest screen you can find. At the very least, [watch this trailer](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkmzxg/mmb7h5h86zdn0/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj11clJWWjRTVzdXVQ==).

bullets.title: Readwise.io
bullets.note: This was introduced to me by my close buddy, Mike, who described it via text: “Basically you integrate with Amazon \[Kindle\], and it sends you a digest every day of 5 to 15 of your past highlights from a random selection of books. \[...\] It also integrates with [Instapaper](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkmzxg/ozukhqhrmd288/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFwYXBlci5jb20v) and [Highly](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkmzxg/p3ieh9hzwon79/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaGlnaGx5LmNvLw==) so you can grab text from the web. Nice and simple.” As the homepage asks: “Highlighting is great, but what's the point if you're never going to see any of those highlights again?”

bullets.title: "I regard consciousness as fundamental. I regard matter as derivative from consciousness. We cannot get behind consciousness.
